subject: Some estimated lv /ov variances are negative

messages.author: d4c32e52e290d408
messages.subject: Some estimated lv /ov variances are negative
parts:
Hello everyone,

Before running my actual multilevel SEM, I wanted to run a CFA according to the steps specified by Hox.
It works fine until I try the independence model. Then I receive this message:
Warning message:
In lav_object_post_check(object) :
  lavaan WARNING: some estimated lv variances are negative

My code looks like this and there are 50 groups of different sizes on level 2 (303 used observations):

####fitting and summary of independence model 7
full_indepmod_pa_ir_we <- cfa(indepmod_pa_ir_we, sample.cov = full_combi.cov, sample.nobs = full_combi.n, orthogonal = T)
summary(full_indepmod_pa_ir_we, fit.measures = TRUE)

To check whether it is also true for other steps, I proceeded with the saturated model, and received the same message. 
When I modelled my actual model, I got another message saying that now the ov variances are negative.

My question now is: what is the meaning of these messages? Does it hurt to ignore them? And how can fix these bugs?

Thank you in advance

Franzi
